channel.title: Slido incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Slido's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Login Issues for Webex Users on all clusters except EU cluster. [resolved]
item.description:
We have confirmed that the login issues affecting Webex users outside the EU have been resolved.
The latest fix has restored normal login access, and our monitoring shows the service is operating normally.
We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

item.title: Login issues [resolved]
item.description:
Our team managed to resolve the issue. We will investigate this incident and ensure we take the necessary steps to prevent this from happening again.
This is not the experience we are committed to delivering to you and we apologize to all whose meetings or events were negatively affected by this disruption. If you have any other questions, please contact us at https://www.slido.com/contact.

item.title: Major Outage of United Arab Emirates region [resolved]
item.description: We now consider this issue to be resolved as we have a functional workaround for users based in the UAE. If you were previously on the UAE server and need access to Slido, please contact support@slido.com and we will be able to set this up for you.

item.title: Major Outage [resolved]
item.description: The issue has now been resolved and the service is operating normally again. Thank you for your patience while this was being addressed.

item.title: Degraded performance [resolved]
item.description: The issue has now been resolved and the service is operating normally again. The problem was caused by an AWS-related outage. We’ve confirmed that DNS lookups are functioning as expected and are continuing to monitor the situation closely. Thank you for your patience while this was being addressed.

item.title: Issue with Google Slides Chrome Extension [resolved]
item.description:
Our Google Slides integration should gradually be returning to normal, although it can take a number of days for the new version of the chrome extension to reach you.
This is something that we don't have any control over so if you find the present mode still isn't loading for you, please continue to use the following workaround:
- Disable the Slido Chrome Extension - Open your presentation in Google Slides - Click the green Present button directly from the Slido sidebar

item.title: Issue with quiz timer [resolved]
item.description:
Our team managed to resolve the issue. We will investigate this incident and ensure we take the necessary steps to prevent this from happening again.
This is not the experience we are committed to delivering to you and we apologize to all whose meetings or events were negatively affected by this disruption. If you have any other questions, please let us know at support@slido.com.

item.title: Invoice Services [resolved]
item.description: A fix on a Braintree side has been implemented and incident is now resolved. Our team confirmed payments are working correctly. We apologize for the inconvenience.

item.title: Help center articles are not accessible [resolved]
item.description: All Help Center articles are available and operational since 15:33 UTC. This incident has been resolved.
